text:
emma_finance: AP flagged invoice QF-INV-03-2026 from QuantumFlux  no PO matched and vendor billed in mixed currencies. Invoice total shows USD 3,200 + EUR 10,000 (they attached both PDFs). Need owner for approval/PO and FX handling.

alec_procure: Searching PO ledger... only see PO-60021 but that's for a consulting SOW and in GBP. Not applicable. :mag_right:

emma_finance: Coupa OCR did not pick up PO (vendor put PO number only in email subject). Also the EUR line got parsed separately so the AP system shows two totals.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice QF-INV-03-2026 uploaded by emma_finance. Status -> routing_hold (missing PO / currency mismatch).

rita_ops: If this is model runtime it should hit 350-Platform. @mel_prod do you own QuantumFlux approvals?

mel_prod: I do. I'm traveling but can approve a retro PO. I need the usage breakdown and the vendor CSV though (specifically currency column). If vendor billed in EUR we need FX guidance.

emma_finance: Pasting vendor CSV excerpt (as provided):

````
date,region,hours,currency,rate_per_hour,amount
2026-02-12,eu-central,800,EUR,12.50,10000.00
2026-02-15,us-east,100,USD,12.00,1200.00
````

alec_procure: Procurement preference: vendor reissue with PO on invoice header and single billing currency. For this month we can create an internal retro PO and route to @mel_prod to avoid delaying payment. We'll note vendor must reissue for audit.

mel_prod: OK. Confirm GL should be 5002 (CloudCompute) or 5003 (ThirdPartyServices)? I lean 5002. Also what's the FX rate to convert EUR -> USD for the ledger?

emma_finance: Finance suggests using bank rate on invoice date: 1 EUR = 1.08 USD (per treasury feed for 2026-02-12). Using that EUR10,000 = USD10,800 so combined USD total = 12,000. Confirm we should record USD12,000 GL amount.

alec_procure: Creating retro PO now: PO-R-2026-888. Supplier QuantumFlux. Routing -> approver: mel_prod. Note: vendor to reissue with PO-R-2026-888 on header and consolidate to single currency.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: PO PO-R-2026-888 created by alec_procure. Invoice QF-INV-03-2026 linked to PO-R-2026-888. Payment hold: set until approval.

vendor_rep: QuantumFlux: we can reissue in EUR only or in USD at your preference. We typically bill in EUR for EU usage. We will reissue with PO on header if you confirm currency.

mel_prod: Approving PO-R-2026-888 contingent on FX conversion at 1.08 and GL 5002 / cost center 350. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval recorded. Payment hold released. Invoice scheduled for payment Net 7 from approval. Finance to post interim accrual and record EUR conversion adjustment entry.

emma_finance: Noted. I'll confirm with vendor we accept EUR reissue (we'll convert at 1.08). Vendor to attach corrected invoice. Finance will reverse accrual when payment posts.

alec_procure: Also adding procurement follow-up: ask vendors to put PO on header and prefer single-currency invoice to avoid OCR issues.

emma_finance: Thanks everyone. I'll close thread after payment posts and attach payment remittance. :white_check_mark:
